teacher: SD2.1 base + unmodified author native LDM decoder and public weights; 50 steps, CFG 3.0
author_evaluation: unmodified run_evals.py plus independent score agreement
student: clean SD1.4 base + its own clean VAE; independently fitted ordinary LoRA on teacher PNG/original captions
controls: one matched clean-data student for each rank/scope: eight long trainings total
scope: attention = to_q/k/v/to_out.0; attention_conv additionally every UNet Conv2d with groups=1; VAE frozen
teacher_guard: 32 independent prompts: mean bit accuracy >=90%, nominal 1% TPR >=90%
detector: official whitened TorchScript, ImageNet normalization, positive-logit bits; no resize of 512px PNG
metrics: image TPR and clean FPR at empirical 1% calibration
calibration: separate clean-student images for each rank/scope; same threshold used on both query arms
checkpoint: fixed final step; no detector-based selection; no loss/algorithm change
sample_pairing: same caption and initial noise for clean/marked teacher and all students
limits: Public SD2.1 demo checkpoint, not the private 2.2B model in paper. LoRA transfer is our extension. Modern PyTorch/Diffusers DDIM runtime, not bitwise original software. One seed; no model-level FPR guarantee.
sampling_source: Paper Appendix A.3: 50 steps, guidance 3.0, first COCO caption per image; query first 1000 images
